title: Strategic direction synthesis and stakeholder readout for inference economics
creator: Priya Desai
description: Purpose: Prepare a compact, decision-oriented readout for execs and GTM stakeholders that synthesizes product direction choices and trade-offs for inference economics. This ticket coordinates the narrative, asks, and artifacts for the March stakeholder briefing. Scope includes: (1) A 6-slide decision pack summarizing trade-offs across batching, KV caching, and quantization recommendations; (2) Risk lanes for Dedicated capacity ramp and Private deployment controls; (3) A short metrics deck showing cost/unit, 95th-p99 latency, and regression risk across candidate model variants; (4) Clear executive asks (budget, capacity commit, go/no-go signals for Private beta). Audience: CEO, CTO, Head of Revenue, Sales Ops, Security.

decision_log: Use continuous-batching baseline for hosted API ask; propose 2 pilot Dedicated pools for latency-sensitive customers.
Delay broad quantization recommendation until A/B eval for reranking tasks completes; recommend targeted quantization for embeddings workloads first.
Present a conditional ask to finance: 20% incremental commit for Dedicated if latency SLOs are met on pilot pools.
